title: Dynamax user request tracker
purpose: Durable checklist for continuing this chat. Read before starting another pass; update evidence and delivery status before closing a request.
evidencePolicy: Evidence paths locate implementation, tests or prior notes; their presence alone does not prove a request is deployed or complete. Preserve historical status until the relevant behavior and deployed artifact are verified. Remaining follow-ups are not claims of implemented features.

statusDefinitions.in_progress: Current pass; not yet claimed delivered.
statusDefinitions.deployed_verified: Verified in this pass with commit/deployment and checks.
statusDefinitions.historical_delivery_to_verify: Request retained from conversation. Existing work/docs may implement it; inspect evidence before marking complete or redoing it.
statusDefinitions.deferred_user_priority: Retained, resume after current urgent school/payment work.
statusDefinitions.tested_awaiting_deployment: Implemented and tests passed; deployment has not yet been verified.
statusDefinitions.deployed_with_followups: Tested changes deployed and verified; the listed cost/rollout follow-ups remain open.
statusDefinitions.recorded_verified: Durable tracker saved and pushed; later requests and delivery evidence must continue to be recorded.

constraints: Preserve all business records, payments and scores; use reviewed corrections and provenance.
Prevent duplicate receipts, charges, reservations and audit events on retry; never invent records.
Minimize unrequested reads/writes; cache loaded views, paginate history and require explicit scoped loads when needed.
Current pass: test, push and deploy web; do not compile or release desktop.
Patient cards remain NFC. Card-terminal payments remain disabled.
Scope every record by organization/workspace, branch and school section; matching admission numbers across branches are allowed.
Historical authorization does not imply historical completion. Record test evidence, source commit and deployed artifact for every closure.
Never store passwords, one-time codes, private financial exports or payment-provider secrets here.

decisions.choice: Clear current fees first, save the remainder for future due school fees.
Allow separate rates by class and term, scoped to branch and billing category.
Branch-specific general link plus one-time code for each branch's parent group, including when parent contacts are not yet known; prevent branch leakage even when admission numbers match.
Allow vendor and organization sales with ownership labels and enable/disable option.
Restore earlier former-arm marks where the user selected that remedy; retain both versions/history.
Apply to total school-fee balance while retaining existing per-item rules.
Ready pupils' scores and results may be submitted, approved and published while incomplete pupils remain pending. Explicitly untaught subjects need a documented exemption rather than invented marks.

Both have the same assigned-classroom access. Give them initial pupil allocation only, open their classroom directly, and retain a read-only classroom score register with preview/print on the web companion.
Move a pupil's working subjects, scores and records with the pupil; do not archive the active records merely because the arm changes. Preserve provenance and score-history evidence.
Load submitted, waiting-confirmation and waiting-approval requests when the module opens. Require date ranges for completed history, not for every setup or navigation screen.
Chess, Graphic and Photography apply to all Main Branch classes in First Term.
Settings Classes & Arms and Academic Management must use the same branch-specific definitions and stable IDs. Preserve placements, scores and history.

items.title: Audit purchase reads/writes and offline suitability
items.acceptance: Reduce repeated catalogue/customer/history work; keep wallet/stock validation atomic. Consider offline alternatives only if measured costs justify them and overspending is prevented.

remainingFollowUps.title: Evaluate a verified wallet-history checkpoint to reduce repeated lifetime reads
remainingFollowUps.acceptance: Measure long-history lookup and purchase costs before changing the accounting path. Any checkpoint must remain branch/student scoped, reconcile with immutable transactions, account for late imports/corrections/refunds, and share the same concurrency guard as purchases. Retain a bounded reconciliation path and all history; do not replace real receipt evidence with a cached balance.
remainingFollowUps.completionEvidence: Document baseline and resulting read/write counts plus concurrent-sale, reversal, delayed-import and retry tests. This remains follow-up work, not a delivered checkpoint.

remainingFollowUps.title: Evaluate safe local-network/offline purchases before enabling them
remainingFollowUps.acceptance: Compare measured online costs with a coordinated local-server or explicitly bounded offline allowance design. Define authority, device limits, conflict handling and replay-safe synchronization so two disconnected tills cannot spend the same wallet funds or stock. Keep offline financial posting disabled until the design and failure tests justify it.
remainingFollowUps.completionEvidence: A documented decision with cost measurements, connectivity assumptions and overspending/duplicate-prevention tests; evaluation does not authorize or claim activation.
